intro: Supernova uses Pythagorean numerology — every letter in the alphabet has a value 1 through 9, and every number carries a different character. From your full birth-certificate name and date of birth, we calculate five core numbers plus several additional layers. This isn't fortune-telling; it's a map of yourself. This page explains every term that shows up in the app, in plain language.

sections.title: The five core numbers
sections.tagline: The foundation of your numerology profile
sections.body:
**Life Path** is calculated from your full date of birth. It's your life's mission or direction — the big lesson that recurs throughout your life. Whether you embrace it or avoid it, this theme keeps showing up.

**Expression** (sometimes Destiny) is calculated from every letter in your full name. It's your natural talents and how you show up in the world — what comes naturally to you, what people see you mastering.

**Soul Urge** (Heart's Desire) is calculated from the vowels in your name. It's your deepest longing — what truly settles or moves you, even if you don't always show it outwardly.

**Personality** is calculated from the consonants. It's the first impression people pick up — the "outer shell" of your energy before they know you deeper.

**Birthday** = the day of the month you were born (1-31). A specific spice that accompanies your whole life — a talent that comes through your birth day itself.

sections.title: Master Numbers (11, 22, 33)
sections.tagline: Compound numbers that are NOT reduced — amplified, but heavy
sections.body:
Normally we reduce numbers down to a single digit (e.g. 29 → 2+9 = 11 → 1+1 = 2). But three numbers — **11, 22, 33** — are called Master Numbers and are NOT reduced further to 2/4/6, because numerology tradition sees them as "amplified" versions of those numbers.

**11** = high intuition, vision, spiritual sensitivity. Intense version of 2.

**22** = master builder, capacity to construct at a large scale. Intense version of 4.

**33** = devotion + universal love. Very rare. Intense version of 6.

If one of your core numbers is a master number, Supernova writes it as the compound + master — e.g. Life Path "29/11/2" means compound 29 → master 11, which would fully reduce to 2. A master number isn't automatically "better" — it carries great potential but also heavier pressure. Many people with master numbers feel their life is a lifetime practice.

sections.title: Karmic Debt (13, 14, 16, 19)
sections.tagline: Specific compound numbers that signal a heavy lesson
sections.body:
Karmic Debt = four specific compound numbers: **13, 14, 16, 19**. If your calculation produces one of these compounds before reducing (e.g. Life Path 31 → 4 is ordinary; but Life Path 22 → 4 via 13 is different), numerology tradition (especially Decoz) reads that as a karmic lesson you're carrying.

**13/4** = hard work building a foundation. Instant results are rare; but consistency yields solid outcomes.

**14/5** = learning self-control inside freedom. Temptation toward excess is real; the lesson is to use freedom with awareness.

**16/7** = old ego and structures must crumble before the true self emerges. Lots of inner work, lots of transformation.

**19/1** = learning to stand on your own without stepping on others. Independent leadership that still honors interdependence.

Karmic Debt is **not a punishment**. It's a signal of areas where the lesson is more intense — and typically where the growth is deeper too. Supernova shows a "karmic" badge next to affected numbers (can be turned off in Settings if it feels labeling).

sections.title: Karmic Lessons
sections.tagline: Digits 1-9 that are ABSENT from your name — areas you'll grow into consciously
sections.body:
Karmic Lessons are different from Karmic Debt — the two often get confused. Karmic Lessons are digits 1 through 9 that **do not appear at all** in the letters of your full name.

Each digit 1-9 symbolizes one domain of life. If the digit IS in your name, you're "familiar" with that domain — it comes naturally. If it's NOT there, that domain is an area you'll need to **develop consciously**, because it doesn't come automatically.

Example: if the digit 5 is absent, you might be too rigid with routine — the lesson: learn adaptation & letting go. If 7 is absent, you may stay too surface — the lesson: learn to go inward.

Its work: not a deficiency, but a growth compass. Some people have no Karmic Lessons (all 1-9 are present in their name) — that doesn't automatically mean an easy life; their lessons come through other channels (Pinnacle, Challenge, Essence).

sections.title: Bridge Numbers
sections.tagline: The gap between two core numbers — how smoothly two sides of you integrate
sections.body:
Bridge Number (Decoz tradition) looks at the **difference** between two core numbers. Supernova shows two main bridges:

**Life Path × Expression** = is your life mission (Life Path) aligned with your natural talents (Expression)? Small gap = your work flows in service of your purpose. Large gap = you may often feel "what I'm good at isn't what I want".

**Soul Urge × Personality** = does the inner self (Soul Urge) show up in the outer impression (Personality)? Small gap = people who just met you grasp you as you are. Large gap = there's distance between "who I really am" vs "who people see".

Bridge **small (0-2)** = flowing, almost no friction.
Bridge **moderate (3-5)** = routine compromise needed.
Bridge **large (6-8)** = the two sides pull strongly against each other — integration takes conscious work, but the deepest growth is often born here.

sections.title: Minor Numbers (from your nickname)
sections.tagline: Your day-to-day layer — if people call you by a short name
sections.body:
The five core numbers are calculated from your birth-certificate name. Minor Numbers are calculated from your **call-by name / nickname** — the one people use day-to-day (e.g. "Mike" from "Michael").

They reflect your **social self** — how your energy shows up when the public calls you by that name. The core profile from the legal name stays as a deeper foundation; the Minor layer is the everyday surface on top.

Three components:
• **Minor Expression** = talents & presence (nickname version)
• **Minor Soul Urge** = motivation brought to the public realm (from the nickname's vowels)
• **Minor Personality** = first impression the public picks up (from the nickname's consonants)

If you don't have a nickname (people always use your full name), Minor Numbers don't appear — the core profile is enough.

sections.title: Personal Year, Month, Day
sections.tagline: The theme that's currently active — moves in a 1→9 cycle
sections.body:
Besides static numbers (Life Path, etc.), numerology also tracks the **theme currently in play**. It moves in a 1→9 cycle that repeats throughout life.

**Personal Year (PY)** = the main theme for the next 12 months. Calculated from (birth month + birth day + current year), resets every January 1 in your timezone. Year 1 = start something new. Year 5 = change & motion. Year 9 = completion before a fresh cycle.

**Personal Month (PM)** = (PY + current month). Resets at the start of each month.

**Personal Day (PD)** = (PM + today's day). Resets daily. This is what powers "today's vibe" on the dashboard.

If your PY/PM/PD compound lands on 13/14/16/19, karmic debt adds an extra dimension of lesson to that period.

sections.title: Pinnacle & Challenge
sections.tagline: Four life chapters — dominant theme + main test
sections.body:
**Pinnacle** = four big chapters of your life, each carrying a dominant theme for several years.

**Chapter 1** runs from birth until age `(36 − reduced Life Path)`. E.g. Life Path 1: Chapter 1 until age 35. Chapters 2, 3, 4 each span 9 years after.

Each Pinnacle comes **paired with a Challenge** — the main shortcoming or test that gets trained in that chapter.

• Pinnacle tells you what's "being cooked" in that chapter.
• Challenge tells you what to **train or wrestle with** in that chapter.

If you're in Chapter 2 with Pinnacle 6 + Challenge 1, the theme is care & responsibility (Pinnacle 6), and the recurring test is learning independence without losing empathy (Challenge 1).

sections.title: Period Cycle (Three Major Waves)
sections.tagline: The energetic backdrop behind the Pinnacles
sections.body:
Unlike Pinnacle (4 themed chapters), Period Cycle is the **3 major energetic waves** of your life — the energy coloring each stage's backdrop.

**Wave 1 — Formative** (~birth-28) from your **birth month**. Foundation energy: who you are getting shaped.

**Wave 2 — Productive** (~28-56) from your **birth day**. Productivity energy: your contribution to the world.

**Wave 3 — Harvest** (~56+) from your **birth year**. Harvest energy: reflection, legacy, wisdom.

Age boundaries shift slightly based on your Life Path (Decoz formula). Pinnacle = THEME of the chapter. Period Cycle = ENERGETIC BACKDROP behind it.

sections.title: Essence Cycle
sections.tagline: Years cooked by the letters of your name
sections.body:
Essence Cycle is the most **personal** layer — it reads the letters of your name one by one.

Each letter "lives" for as many years as its Pythagorean value. E.g. D = 4 → active 4 years. Y = 7 → active 7 years. When one letter finishes, the next letter in that name begins.

Three streams run **in parallel**:
• **Physical Transit** from the first name — physical, work, manifestation
• **Mental Transit** from the middle name (if any) — thoughts, ideas, decisions
• **Spiritual Transit** from the last name — inner growth, relationships, connection

**This year's Essence** = the sum of the currently-active letters across the three streams. If the result is a compound 13/14/16/19, it is **preserved** (not reduced) — a signal that the year carries a specific lesson.

sections.title: Talents & Vocations
sections.tagline: The digit distribution profile of your name
sections.body:
Each letter has a value 1-9. Your full name is a collection of letters, so the digit distribution can be measured — which digits are **dominant** (appear often), which are **thin**, which are **completely absent**.

This distribution maps to talent groups:
• **Mind** (1, 5, 7) — thought, independence, research
• **Creative** (3, 6, 9) — expression, care, big vision
• **Structure** (2, 4, 8) — collaboration, systems, execution

And to **vocations** — work fields whose digit structure matches your distribution (e.g. Business & Management, Medicine & Education, Arts & Communication, etc.).

The **High/Medium/Low** rating on each group = how strong the signal is in your name. Not a career prediction — more of a compass: fields that will feel natural vs fields that need extra work.

sections.title: Compatibility Score
sections.tagline: How two charts "talk" to each other
sections.body:
Score 0-100, calculated from the pairings of your core numbers × the other person's. Authoritative reference: Decoz/McCants matrix.

Five bands:
• **Tough** (< 40) — energies often collide, but the friction can be growth territory
• **Fair** (40-60) — some aligned areas + some friction, conscious compromise needed
• **Good** (60-75) — base flow is comfortable, occasional adjustments
• **Strong** (75-90) — lots of alignment, natural dynamic
• **Rare** (90+) — uncommon combination, deeply aligned

**Lens** = the relationship perspective. Partner, family, friend, colleague each weight components differently. Soul Urge (deepest longing), for example, counts fully for partner & family but not for friend/colleague — because friendships rarely touch that layer.

**Modifier** = special patterns that appear beyond the raw score — e.g. "both carrying a master number", "shared karmic debt", "old soul". They add narrative color, not overriding the main score.
